taskReference.zh-CN: 此任务的原引用尚未核对，请打开任务动态查看。
taskReference.en: The original task reference could not be verified. Open task activity to check it.

frameUnavailable.zh-CN: 原页面的画面引用不可用。
frameUnavailable.en: The original page image is unavailable.

controllerNotReady.en: The local service is not ready.

pairDetail.zh-CN: 此连接可查看本机 {brand} 项目和原会话、发送消息与运行中指导、停止选定任务，以及打开已记录的报告。模型配置与密钥仍由 {brand} 管理。
pairDetail.en: This connection can view local {brand} projects and conversations, send messages and instructions during a task, stop a selected task, and open recorded reports. {brand} keeps control of model settings and credentials.

closingReview.zh-CN: {brand} 正在核查关闭状态，请在桌面端处理。
closingReview.en: {brand} is checking its shutdown status. Review it in the desktop app.

pythonMissing.zh-CN: 随软件交付的 Python 运行环境不存在。请检查完整安装包。
pythonMissing.en: The bundled Python runtime is missing. Check the complete installation package.

launcherMissing.zh-CN: 离线安装包缺少服务启动器，请重新解压完整安装包。
launcherMissing.en: The offline package is missing its service launcher. Extract the complete package again.

serviceStartFailed.zh-CN: 本地服务启动失败，详情见 controller-boot.log。
serviceStartFailed.en: The local service could not start. See controller-boot.log.

serviceStartExited.zh-CN: 本地服务在就绪前已退出，详情见 controller-boot.log。
serviceStartExited.en: The local service exited before it was ready. See controller-boot.log.

serviceTimeout.zh-CN: 本地服务在 180 秒内未就绪，请查看 controller-boot.log。
serviceTimeout.en: The local service was not ready within 180 seconds. See controller-boot.log.

owningPageRequired.zh-CN: 此操作仅限当前主窗口。
owningPageRequired.en: This action is only available from the owning main window.

visibleTaskUnknown.zh-CN: 无法核对选中任务，请刷新任务动态。
visibleTaskUnknown.en: The selected task could not be verified. Refresh task activity.

settingsClosing.zh-CN: 应用正在关闭，请稍后再设置。
settingsClosing.en: The app is closing. Change settings after it has restarted.

orbUnavailable.zh-CN: 此设备无法设置桌面快捷入口。
orbUnavailable.en: The desktop shortcut is unavailable on this device.

flushReference.zh-CN: 退出保存回执不属于当前请求。
flushReference.en: The save receipt does not belong to the current shutdown request.

draftUnsaved.zh-CN: 仍有内容未能保存，窗口已保留；请核对草稿后再关闭。
draftUnsaved.en: Some content could not be saved. The window remains open; check your drafts before closing it.

operationRequired.zh-CN: 需要准确的原操作引用。
operationRequired.en: An exact original operation reference is required.

operationMissing.zh-CN: 服务中没有找到此操作回执；执行结果仍需核查，未自动重新发送。
operationMissing.en: No receipt was found for this operation. Check its outcome; it has not been sent again.

chooseFiles.zh-CN: 选择资料或 Word 模板
chooseFiles.en: Choose source files or a Word template

skillRequired.zh-CN: 需要准确的 Skill 引用。
skillRequired.en: An exact Skill reference is required.

capabilityRequired.en: An exact capability reference is required.

openStopped.zh-CN: 应用正在关闭，已停止打开文档。
openStopped.en: Document opening stopped because the app is closing.

openSuperseded.zh-CN: 已有新的打开操作，此请求已失效。
openSuperseded.en: A newer document-open action has replaced this request.

presentationChanged.zh-CN: 协作视图已变化，请重新选择要打开的文档。
presentationChanged.en: The collaboration view has changed. Select the document again.

documentUnresolved.zh-CN: 尚未找到可打开的本地文档。
documentUnresolved.en: The local document could not be resolved.

wordPathTooLong.zh-CN: 文稿路径过长，Word 无法可靠打开。文件和当前草稿已保留；请缩短文件路径，生成稿请改用较短的 Cirven 安装目录。
wordPathTooLong.en: The document path is too long for Word to open reliably. Your file and current draft are preserved. Shorten the file path; for generated documents, use a shorter Cirven installation path.

previewUnavailable.zh-CN: 当前页的准确预览暂不可用。
previewUnavailable.en: An exact preview of the current page is unavailable.

imageBytesChanged.zh-CN: 当前页图像内容已变化，请重新获取。
imageBytesChanged.en: The current page image has changed. Capture it again.

imageDimensionsChanged.zh-CN: 当前页图像尺寸已变化，请重新获取。
imageDimensionsChanged.en: The current page image dimensions have changed. Capture it again.

exitAbnormal.zh-CN: 本地服务未正常退出。应用保持打开，退出结果需要核查。
exitAbnormal.en: The local service did not exit normally. The app remains open so you can check the outcome.

exitUnknown.zh-CN: 本地服务退出结果未知。应用保持打开，未强制终止进程。
exitUnknown.en: The local service exit could not be confirmed. The app remains open; no process was forcibly terminated.

exitWait.zh-CN: 已请求关闭，本地服务在 45 秒内尚未确认正常退出。应用保持打开，未重新发送关闭请求。
exitWait.en: Shutdown was requested, but a normal exit was not confirmed within 45 seconds. The app remains open; the request has not been sent again.

previousExitUnknown.zh-CN: 上次关闭结果仍需核查。本地服务尚未确认正常退出，未重新发送关闭请求。
previousExitUnknown.en: The previous shutdown outcome still needs checking. A normal service exit is not confirmed; the request has not been sent again.

exitContextMissing.zh-CN: 缺少可核对的本地服务关闭上下文。应用保持打开。
exitContextMissing.en: The local service shutdown context could not be verified. The app remains open.

ownersNotClosed.zh-CN: 任务或原生协作尚未确认关闭。应用保持打开，当前执行结果需要核查。
ownersNotClosed.en: Task or native collaboration shutdown is not confirmed. The app remains open so you can check the current outcome.

nativeWindowNotDetached.zh-CN: 原软件窗口尚未安全移出工作台。请重试关闭，以保留当前编辑。
nativeWindowNotDetached.en: The original application window has not safely left the workspace. Check your edits before trying to close again.

executionNotClosed.zh-CN: 自有执行尚未确认关闭。应用保持打开，未重新发送关闭请求。
executionNotClosed.en: Owned execution shutdown is not confirmed. The app remains open; the request has not been sent again.

flushTimeout.zh-CN: 退出前的草稿保存尚未确认，应用保持打开。
flushTimeout.en: Draft saving has not been confirmed. The app remains open.

idePaused.zh-CN: VS Code 连接已暂停；退出结果确认前不会重新执行任务。
idePaused.en: The VS Code connection is paused. Tasks will not run again while the shutdown outcome is unconfirmed.

artifactUnowned.zh-CN: 这份产物不属于已记录的回答。
artifactUnowned.en: This artifact does not belong to a recorded reply.

artifactNoFile.zh-CN: 这份产物尚无可原生打开的文件引用。
artifactNoFile.en: This artifact has no file reference that can be opened in its native application.

initialCapture.zh-CN: 初始化当前原生页面身份

taskUpdateOne.en: A task has an update. Open to view it.

languageUnsupported.zh-CN: 请选择跟随系统、简体中文或 English。
languageUnsupported.en: Choose System, Simplified Chinese, or English.

preferencesFailed.zh-CN: 设置未能保存，请检查安装目录写入权限后重试。
preferencesFailed.en: Settings could not be saved. Check write access to the installation folder and try again.
